> Authentication. TENANT SCOPE `resolveTenant` has already run app-wide, so `req.tenant` is the organization named by the Host header — and it is absent on the apex and on admin.<root>, which is exactly how a platform admin signs in without belonging to any tenant. `requireTenant` is deliberately NOT applied to this router. Login has to work on both surfaces, and the per-route logic below decides which organization (if any) the session is scoped to. RATE LIMITING `authLimiter` on everything: these are the endpoints worth brute-forcing. OTP additionally gets `otpLimiter`, which meters per phone number rather than per IP so rotating addresses cannot spam one person's handset.
